Package com.helix.experiments.benchmarks

Class L4CacheBenchmark

java.lang.Object
com.helix.experiments.benchmarks.L4CacheBenchmark
Direct Known Subclasses:
L4CacheBenchmark_jmhType_B1
public class L4CacheBenchmark extends Object
JMH Microbenchmark suite comparing: 1. L1 Caffeine in-memory cache hit (<12 ns) 2. L4 Redis distributed cache hit (<450 us over loopback TCP) 3. Cold ASM rule compilation (~250 us)
